Title: Analyst US Corporates
Description: Analyst, US Corporates Group – Monterrey Fitch Ratings is currently seeking an Analyst for coverage of the US Corporates Group based out of our Monterrey office. What We Offer Fitch is a team-oriented work environment, so excellent communication skills are essential, as is a high productivity work-ethic and results oriented mindset. An opportunity to be in a sector team at a global rating agency. A role and platform that helps the debt capital markets make more informed decisions via timely, insightful and forward-looking rating actions and research. We’ll Count On You To Perform data analysis of key quantitative and qualitative factors influencing the US Corporates group, in support of existing ratings, new rating mandates and research. Become an expert on the model used to derive credit opinion recommendations. Take ownership of number of credits to which Fitch assigns a credit assessment. Maintain comprehensive financial models. Prepare internal reports tracking key operational trends to inform senior staff and empower them to make good strategic planning decisions within the department. Occasionally collaborate with senior team members to publish research on US Corporates topics, for Fitch’s external audience which includes institutional investors, private equity sponsors, private debt funds, CLO managers, HY mutual fund managers and credit hedge funds. Support Senior Analysts prepare presentations for internal credit rating committees; Participate in the evaluation of other credits within US Corporates, as well as other related credit groups. What You Need To Have 1-2 years of relevant experience. Bachelor's degree required. Advanced English proficiency (Bilingual). (Leverage Finance) Demonstrate interest in Leveraged Finance/Private Credit. Exposure to financial statement analysis in a work or classroom setting. Expertise in Microsoft Excel. Strong analytical, quantitative, and organizational skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to shift fluidly between multiple projects as priorities change. Ability to excel in a team-oriented environment. CFA/CPA or CFA candidate preferred. What Would Make You Stand Out Demonstrated interest in credit analysis. Wants to deepen their exposure to and understanding of the debt capital markets. Has exposure to financial statement analysis in a work or classroom setting. Has solid interpersonal skills displayed by a strong pattern of leadership and the ability to interact with various stakeholders proactively and successfully across a variety of departments within the organization. Why Fitch? At Fitch Group, the combined power of our global perspectives is what differentiates us. Our global network of colleagues comes together to accomplish things greater than they ever could alone. Every team member is essential to our business and each perspective is critical to our success. We embrace a diverse culture that encourages a free exchange of ideas, guaranteeing your voice will be heard and your work will have an impact, regardless of seniority. We are building incredible things at Fitch and we invite you to join us on our journey. Fitch Group is a global leader in financial information services with operations in more than 30 countries. Wholly owned by the Hearst Corporation, we are comprised of three main businesses: Fitch Ratings | Fitch Solutions | Fitch Learning. For More Information Please Visit Our Websites www.fitchratings.com | www.fitchsolutions.com | www.fitchlearning.com Fitch is committed to providing global securities markets with objective, timely, independent and forward-looking credit opinions. To protect Fitch’s credibility and reputation, our employees must take every precaution to avoid conflicts of interests or any appearance of a conflict of interest. Should you be successful in the recruitment process at Fitch Ratings you will be asked to declare any securities holdings and other potential conflicts prior to commencing employment. If you, or your immediate family, have any holdings that may conflict with your work responsibilities, you may be asked to divest yourself of them before beginning work. Fitch Group is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, and other statuses protected by law.

Title: Paid Media & Growth Operations Manager
Description: Role summary Own the execution, measurement, optimization, and client communication for paid-growth programs across Knight Vision client accounts. Turn approved strategy and creative into well-run campaigns, reliable conversion tracking, clear reporting, and an actionable plan for improving results. Responsibilities Paid-media execution ●      Build, launch, manage, and optimize campaigns across Meta and Google Ads. ●      Own campaign structure, budgets, targeting, placements, creative setup, landing-page links, platform settings, and conversion objectives. ●      Audit accounts to identify the most important gaps in campaign setup, tracking, funnel flow, creative delivery, and optimization. ●      Monitor spend, pacing, volume, cost per result, and lead quality. ●      Make and implement optimization recommendations, including changes to targeting, budgets, campaign objectives, conversion events, landing pages, and creative inputs. ●      Set up campaigns and operational tasks quickly once scope and approvals are clear. Measurement and growth operations ●      Own conversion measurement from ad interaction through lead capture and CRM visibility. ●      Implement and troubleshoot GTM, pixels, conversion events, UTMs, forms, CRM integrations, and lead routing. ●      Validate tracking end to end before reporting performance or recommending scaled spend. ●      Identify reporting, attribution, or client-infrastructure blockers early and recommend a clear path to resolution. ●      Partner with strategy, creative, and client teams to translate performance needs into concrete requirements for ads, forms, landing pages, and tracking. Client reporting and communication ●      Lead weekly paid-media client calls, presenting performance, answering operational questions, and aligning on priorities. ●      Deliver clear weekly reporting for every active account, covering spend, conversion volume, cost per result, lead-quality signals, meaningful changes, and progress toward agreed goals. ●      Clearly distinguish verified performance data from low-volume results, incomplete tracking, assumptions, and client-side blockers. ●      Explain what happened, why it matters, what will be tested next, and what decision, asset, access, or feedback is needed from the client. ●      Maintain a simple live view of current activity, results, blockers, and next steps so clients can easily understand the state of their account. ●      Send concise follow-ups after calls, with ownership and timing for agreed actions. Success measures ●      Campaigns launch accurately and on time. ●      Tracking is validated from ad click through lead capture and CRM reporting. ●      Weekly client calls and reports are clear, accurate, and useful. ●      Spend is paced to approved budgets and optimization goals. ●      Cost per qualified lead, booked appointment, trial, purchase, or other agreed conversion improves over time. ●      Client blockers are surfaced early and resolved with clear ownership. ●      Paid accounts become increasingly scalable because their tracking, creative inputs, conversion paths, and reporting are operationally sound. Required strengths ●      Strong working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads. ●      Hands-on GTM, pixel, conversion-event, UTM, and CRM troubleshooting experience. ●      Practical understanding of conversion funnels, landing pages, lead quality, and attribution. ●      Ability to interpret performance data without overstating what it proves. ●      Confident client-facing communication and the ability to lead a focused weekly performance call. ●      Strong organization and follow-through across multiple client accounts.
ShortDescription: Manage and optimize paid media campaigns across Meta and Google Ads for client accounts, ensuring effective execution, measurement, and client communication. Responsibilities include campaign management, tracking setup, conversion measurement, client reporting, and addressing operational blockers to improve results.
TechStack: Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, GTM, CRM, pixel tracking, UTM parameters
